title: These are awful!!
text: These are awful!!. I have used pads similar to this!  Never have I seen such junky pads!  When washed they separate except for the very edges!  They don’t even lay flat!!!  I am telling you all, Do NOT waste your money!!!  Get the better made ones!!  I have been using the white ones for a couple years & they wash great & last long!  Theses are horrible!!!!
